description: This file contains functions for freezing and optimizing TorchScript modules, including freezing a ScriptModule, running optimizations on frozen graphs, and preparing models for inference. It is part of the torch.jit module for model serialization and optimization.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Freezes a ScriptModule by inlining submodules and attributes as constants, with options to preserve attributes and optimize numerics.

methods.name: run_frozen_optimizations
methods.description: Applies a series of graph optimizations to a frozen ScriptModule, such as removing dropout and folding layers.

methods.name: optimize_for_inference
methods.description: Performs optimization passes on a ScriptModule to prepare it for inference, including freezing if necessary.
